title: CI interpreter coverage and shard timing
summary: Linux workflows pin Ubuntu 24.04, including YOKE_LINUX_RUNS_ON defaults; self-hosted overrides must select the same supported substrate. The moving ubuntu-latest label upgraded to Ubuntu 26.04 without PostgreSQL 16 host clients or libxml2.so.2 needed by copy-lifetime and embedded PostgreSQL admission fixtures. Runner upgrades require full CI proof on both Python endpoints. The separate Check runner capacity step measures the median of three Python loops before Run pytest. Values above 0.05 seconds refuse as ci_runner_slow with measured value, limit and recovery, retained in pytest-output.txt. When only capacity failed, item-owned rerun-failed permits failed-job recovery within three total attempts; pytest or other step failures still refuse ci_rerun_verdict. Setup precedes admission; later host degradation remains outside this check. The pytest step uses PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1.
